name: Lipschitz Step Size Ray Marching
aliases: Ray Marching with Lipschitz Step Size
SDF ray marching with Lipschitz constant
definition: Iteratively steps along a ray using an SDF to find surface intersections, scaling the step size by a Lipschitz constant to guarantee convergence without overshooting.
summary: Lipschitz Step Size Ray Marching is a robust algorithm that finds surface intersections by using a global Lipschitz constant to compute safe step sizes, preventing overshoot without requiring local gradient estimation.
